title: Nigeria UBEC 2022 Primary and Secondary Schools Snapshot
description: Schools observed in the official UBEC 2022 Primary and Junior Secondary school-directory snapshots. Inclusion does not independently establish current operational or licensing status, and this is not a complete current senior-secondary or private-school register.
source_observation_policy: One public record per reconciled UBEC school/campus identity; combined source rows contribute multiple education_levels. The public contract retains UBEC school_code only when one code maps to one final identity.
source_hierarchy: state ministries and SUBEBs for future reconciliation
GRID3 Nigeria Schools for supporting geospatial evidence

sources.title: 2022 Basic Education School List
sources.publication_date: 2022 snapshot; published at this URL in 2024-04
limitations: ECCDE and primary are combined in source labels

sources.title: 2022 Basic Education Junior Secondary School List
sources.publication_date: 2022 snapshot; published at this URL in 2024-04
limitations: JSS and SSS are combined in one source label

quarantine_reason: UBEC Osun ILESHA does not identify East versus West LGA and is not guessed.

ownership_mapping.government_owner: omitted unless UBEC distinguishes federal, state or local authority

id_strategy: normalized school name plus state, LGA and town; UBEC code is used only as a final deterministic disambiguator when necessary.
rights: SoftData compilation, schema and metadata are CC BY 4.0. UBEC source publications retain their own rights. No personal or individual-level data is included.
known_limitations: The source is a 2022 directory snapshot, not an active licensing register.
Senior-secondary coverage is inferred only from UBEC JSS AND SSS rows; SSS-only schools are not present in the canonical workbook.
69 rows with ambiguous Osun ILESHA geography are quarantined.
LGA and ownership semantics require future cross-source validation.
implementation_status: static source-observed dataset foundation; repository, service and HTTP support are intentionally deferred
